deterministic_experiments.task: 输出一个 JSON 对象，键为 name、age、skills；skills 必须是恰好 3 个字符串；不得输出 Markdown 代码围栏或解释。
只输出一条 SQLite 查询：从 users 表读取 age 大于参数 :min_age 的 name，并按 name 升序排序。不得使用字面数字 18，不得输出 Markdown 围栏或解释。
只输出 Python 代码：实现 safe_divide(a: float, b: float) -> float | None；b 为 0 时返回 None；包含 docstring；不得输出 Markdown 围栏或解释。

documented_failure_case.problem: Before output normalization, all three deterministic tasks failed JSON/Python checks because the model wrapped correct content in Markdown fences.
documented_failure_case.observation: The engine did not mark these runs as verified improvements.
documented_failure_case.fix: Added traceable candidate sanitization with raw_answer and postprocessed fields, keeping external checks independent.
documented_failure_case.result_after_fix: All three tasks reached target at baseline after normalization, so no further candidate search was required.
